summary: The code is approved in substance: the round-2 finding and three minors are fixed in b67efab8, the merge 6b5c1050 resolves only packages/envoy/AGENTS.md, and my prose commit 4a9fcec3 corrects appendingCursor's comment. This PR changes nothing under internal/broker, docs/kubernetes.md or the delivery hub (git diff f4ec92ee ee1add8e on those paths is empty). Every other job of attempt 1 succeeded. A re-run reuses the old merge ref, so only a new head picks up main's fixes.
